premises.text: Millions lack or have subprime credit because building history requires credit first, making credit expensive and limiting
premises.evidence_span: in order to build or establish credit, first, you need credit. It's a fundamental catch-22

premises.text: Self Lender lets users choose affordable monthly deposits that are reported to credit bureaus and returned at term end to build payment history
premises.evidence_span: Self Lender enables our users to build positive payment history, the most important factor in determining your credit score

premises.text: Signup is cheap and simple at about $3 per month with selectable amounts and terms
premises.evidence_span: Signing up with Self Lender is easy, takes less than three minutes, and only costs $3 per month

premises.text: Internal payment data unlocks exclusive affordable lending offers such as lower-rate auto loans
premises.evidence_span: Self Lender uses her payment data internally to offer her exclusive lending opportunities

value.text: People build credit, save money, and access affordable financial products
value.evidence_span: the new revolutionary way to bill credit, save money, and gain access to affordable financial products

causal_links.evidence_span: Not having credit is expensive and very limiting
build positive payment history, the most important factor in determining your credit score
use her new credit score to save money

notes: No-score/subprime stats and Dolores car-interest story folded as one credit catch-22 pain (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Monthly amount/term choices and refund-at-end folded into credit-builder mechanism; $3 fee kept with that commercial offer (§4.1.3). Lifetime savings aggregates treated as traction/impact framing.
